content.short: Thruster is the primary native DEX on Blast, featuring standard and concentrated liquidity with native yield.
content.description:
Thruster is the definitive decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively for the Blast Layer 2 network. The platform is specifically engineered to integrate with Blast's unique native yield mechanics, allowing liquidity providers to earn yield on ETH and stablecoins automatically in addition to trading fees. Thruster offers a versatile trading environment that features both standard AMM pools (Uniswap V2 style) and concentrated liquidity pools (Uniswap V3 style) to ensure maximum capital efficiency for all users.

Deeply integrated with the Blast ecosystem, Thruster serves as a primary venue for trading ecosystem tokens and bootstrapping new projects. The protocol focuses on professional-grade performance and transparent on-chain execution, providing a seamless user experience with sub-second finality. By leveraging the high throughput and native incentives of the Blast network, Thruster is building the essential infrastructure needed for participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with unparalleled ease and security.
content.meta: Thruster provides high-speed AMM and concentrated liquidity trading with native yield on the Blast network.
